advice.insufficientHistory: Complete this exercise at least twice to get a recommendation.
advice.longBreak: It's been a while. Use the same weight as last time or go slightly lighter.
advice.laterPosition: You're doing this exercise later in the workout today. Stick with your current weight.
advice.increaseTooHeavy: Go back to your previous weight and build up your reps again.
advice.addRep: Keep the same weight and try adding one rep.
advice.lastWorkoutWeaker: Your performance dropped last time. Start with the last weight you could lift for 8–10 reps.
advice.repeatedBelowRange: This weight is still a bit heavy. Go back to a weight you can lift for 8–10 reps.
advice.stronglyBelowRange: Go back to a weight you can lift for 8–10 reps.
advice.belowRange: Keep your current working weight and aim for at least 8 reps.
advice.sharpSetDrop: Try resting longer between heavy sets or stopping short of failure on your first heavy set.
advice.unstableUpperRange: Keep the same weight and aim for at least 10 reps on each heavy set.
advice.stableUpperRange: Try increasing your working weight by 20% for sets of 8–10 reps.
advice.upperRangeReached: You're close to the top of the rep range. Repeat the same weight and reps to build consistency.
advice.fallingResult: Use the same weight as last time, or go slightly lighter if you still can't reach 8 reps.
advice.stagnantResult: Keep the same weight and try adding one rep to at least one heavy set.
advice.earlierPosition: You're doing this exercise earlier in the workout today. Try to beat your last result.
advice.default: Use the same weight and aim for consistent reps across your working sets.
